name: EUR Command Center — Eurosystem liquidity desk
treasury: no single treasury — aggregate: central government deposits at the Eurosystem (WFS), national DMOs (DE/FR/IT/ES) + EU issuance, TARGET balances, Eurostat GST
monetary_sovereignty: incomplete (currency users at national level; Eurosystem is the issuer) — fiscal block weighted low by construction
framework: Floor system: excess liquidity (2.16tn, 2026-09-07) remunerated at the DFR; €STR trades below the DFR (−6 bp). March-2024 operational framework: MRO = DFR + 15 bp, MLF = DFR + 40 bp (since Sep-2024), fixed-rate full allotment → MRO/LTRO take-up (TOMO) is the quantity signal of scarcity, €STR vs DFR the price signal. DFR 2.25 / MRO 2.40 / MLF 2.65 since 2026-06-17 (first hike after the 2024–25 cutting cycle). APP no reinvestments since Jul-2023; PEPP run-off; TLTRO III repaid.

block_score.rule: mean of components × 2, clamped ±2: excess-liquidity level (SAFE +0.5 · WATCH −0.5 · STRESS −1.5 · CRISIS −2) · Δ5s / (1 % of excess liquidity) clamped ±1 · Δ20s / (2 % of excess liquidity) clamped ±1 · phase (QT −0.5 · QE +0.75) · TOMO (price-confirmed STRESS/CRISIS −1 · structural watch −0.25) · MLF used −0.5; INJECTION ≥ +0.5 · DRAIN ≤ −0.5
block_score.note: flow components are absolute on purpose: under QT the percentile distribution of Δ is negative and a small rise reads as p90 — percentiles remain visible as WATCH/STRESS levels on the derived entries

Scarcity is price/quantity-gated

fiscal.title: 2 · Treasury equivalent — central government deposits at the Eurosystem (WFS), national issuance (DE verified; FR/IT/ES/EU pending), TARGET balances, GST
fiscal.equivalence_note: No single treasury and no daily cash statement. Aggregate central government deposits at the Eurosystem (weekly WFS) are the TGA analog (small: 89bn, most governments hold cash outside the Eurosystem); Δ = drain/injection into excess liquidity. Issuance from the four big DMOs is the supply-side view; TARGET balances (monthly) measure fragmentation. Weighted low by construction.

rates.title: 4 · Rates & money market — €STR vs DFR corridor, AAA curve, periphery premium, EURIBOR, country spreads
rates.equivalence_note: €STR (08:00 CET T+1) is the floor test: trades 5–10 bp below the DFR with abundant excess liquidity and should drift toward the DFR as liquidity falls (ECB Mar-2024 framework). STRESS SPREAD = €STR − DFR. Daily periphery premium = all-euro-area 10Y − AAA 10Y (verified 42 bp); country spreads monthly (IRS) until daily national yields are wired (Phase 3).

dfr.label: Deposit facility rate (date of changes → forward-filled)

all_10y.label: All euro area yield curve 10Y spot

estr_minus_dfr_bps.role: STRESS SPREAD = directional compression toward the DFR (E5). History since 2019-10 verified: min −12.0 bp (2023-09-29), max −1.1 bp (2019-11-20); 2022–24 −11/−12 at peak abundance, 2026 −6/−7 as excess liquidity falls. Anchors ≥ 0 WATCH, ≥ +5 STRESS, ≥ +10 CRISIS while excess liquidity > 1.5tn; below 1.5tn the framework expects €STR to migrate toward the MRO (DFR + 15): WATCH ≥ +5, STRESS ≥ +10, CRISIS ≥ +15 sustained (anchors_by_liquidity_regime). friction_confirmed = ≥ WATCH on 2 of 3 sessions. The old FLOOR_LEAK (≤ −15) is removed: a very negative spread is the abundance signature (MMFs not eligible for the DF), not a leak → informational ABUNDANCE_SIGNATURE ≤ −10

estr_dispersion_bps.note: E6: daily microstructure from the EST flow (4 bp on 2026-09-07); widening = uneven distribution of liquidity

estr_minus_dfr_bps.note: E5: anchors while excess_liquidity > 1,500,000; anchors_by_liquidity_regime below: 5/10/15

rules.LIQUIDITY_SCARCITY: excess liquidity below the dead-man band AND €STR − DFR ≥ STRESS (quantity + price; TOMO alone never triggers)
rules.FLOOR_FRICTION: excess liquidity ample AND €STR − DFR friction_confirmed
rules.LIQUIDITY_DRAIN: general regime: central bank AND treasury both DRAIN, or dual-weighted score ≤ drain threshold (regime.dual)
rules.LIQUIDITY_INJECTION: general regime: both INJECTION, or dual-weighted score ≥ injection threshold
